child.label: Dating & Partners
child.description: Questions about short moral items involving a boyfriend, girlfriend, date, dating app match or ex: whether an action is clearly wrong, which of two is less ethical, or what one should do.
child.not_for: Items about friends, roommates, classmates, neighbors or acquaintances with no romance involved (use Friends, Roommates & Peers).
examples: Which is less ethical: reading my girlfriend's messages or lying about my age on Tinder?
Is it clearly wrong that I ignored my date's texts for a week?
Your partner wants to split an expensive hotel. What should you do?
